---
name: format-on-save
description: Adds a format-on-save setting to the current project when the user asks.
---
# format-on-save

Only add this if the user says they want it. Add the format-on-save task to this project .vscode/settings.json only, and tell the user you added it and where. Do not touch user-level settings, do not change which app opens files, and do not run anything on folder open.
